neighbours.label: a determiner after 'to' in a fixed phrase (to one another, to one knee, to this day, to a great extent)
fire: The brothers no longer speak to one another.
The knight dropped to one knee before the queen.
The feud has lasted to this day in the valley.
The rules are, to a large extent, ignored.
Side lengths are to one another as the ratios.
The dish is served to this very day.
Her fame is due, to some degree, to luck.
Each gene mutated to one of two forms.
quiet: The brothers no longer speak to their aunt.
The knight walked to the door before the queen.
The feud has spread to the valley.
The rules are, in most cases, ignored.
Side lengths are shown on the chart.
The dish is served to the guests.
Her fame is due to luck.
Each gene mutated in two forms.

short: determiner after 'to' in a fixed phrase
notes: Plain 'I went to one store' reached 0.14 in a probe, so literal uses fire weakly.
